about: Constants typed into a cell, read under the Sheet's culture (ADR-0048), and the format a typed constant gives a General cell. Excel's side is typed through Range.FormulaLocal, so the machine's regional format must match the case's culture. Where FormulaLocal reads an entry differently from Excel's cell editor (a leading + or -), the keyboard is what a user types, so the case follows the keyboard and the oracle skips it.
